bounds: a root and one child, two criteria each, hard or soft; floors of one and two hard gates; at most six changes of shape or confirmations

cases.purpose: With a floor of one hard gate, the kernel's confirmation and delivery are the ones the specification calls for.
The same with a floor of two, which the root's count over the tree must meet.
A tree with its child is delivered at some point, so the rule is live.
The same with a floor of two.
